Problem Statement
Create a Binary Search Tree from given integers and find the minimum and maximum values stored in the tree.
Description
Read n integers and insert them into a Binary Search Tree. Find the minimum value by following left child links and the maximum value by following right child links. Print both values.
Input Description
The first line contains an integer n. The second line contains n space-separated integers to be inserted into the Binary Search Tree.
Output Description
Print the minimum value on the first line and the maximum value on the second line.
Sample Input
7
50 30 70 20 40 60 80
Sample Output
20
80
